product_metadata.title: Honey-Can-Do GAR-01767 Dual Rod Expandable Garment Rack with Wheels, ,Black,60in L x 17in W x 73in H
features: Adjustable rack hangs tomorrow’s outfit or a load of air-dry-only delicates
Roll across and between spaces on set of locking wheels
Chrome finish on stainless steel frame for timeless, utilitarian aesthetic
Store shoes in the rack at the bottom
Dimensions: 60'' W x 17'' D x 73'' H
description: This clothes rack is adjustable in more ways than just sizing its rods up and down. Granted, that’s a handy feature. But we mostly appreciate how this portable clothes rack can adjust to many circumstances. With its locking caster wheels, we move this into the bedroom the night before a presentation to try out outfits. On laundry day, it’s rolled onto the patio for delicates to air-dry. When we’re entertaining, this double clothes rack is at the entryway for guests to hang their coats. And those are just a few of our faves. How will this garment rack adjust for you?
